worldcombat.skill.secretpower.summary: A short borrowed strike: fire ignites, plants lull to sleep, water and rain conduct paralysis; otherwise a plain hit. The direct form trades the site's effect for higher power.
worldcombat.skill.secretpower.descriptio: On hit the material under the target becomes a secondary effect (fire to burn, plants to sleep, water or rain to paralysis, otherwise paralysis); chance %1$s, doubled in water or rain.
worldcombat.skill.secretpower.timing: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.secretpower.preference: On: ignore the site, hit harder and always roll paralysis. Off: borrow the site, lower base power but can ignite, lull or conduct.
Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to borrow the site; when off it stays put.
When on, a target already carrying burn, paralysis, sleep, frozen, poison or toxic is skipped.
